source: Q157 (2026-09-25): builds ONE self-contained, full-body Z-Anatomy reference viewer (every non-excluded category in one page) reproducing the owner's preferred August viewer's UI, fed by this project's own Z-Anatomy pipeline (corrections + atlas records included, clinical excluded by construction -- see scripts/zanatomy/build_zan_atlas_viewer.py).

origin.method: least-squares sphere fit (engine.vh_ingest.fit_sphere) to each Femur.l/.r mesh's own proximal-most 15mm-by-atlas-Y cap -- a cheap proxy for the femoral head ball (Z-Anatomy ships no separate femoral head cartilage object); see module docstring for the RMS-vs-cap-size measurement that picked 15mm.
